values.note: recreation.gov lists 37 sites: 35 standard sites open to RVs and trailers (24 reservable, 11 first-come) and 2 tent-only; the FS page says 38 (24 reservable, 14 first-come). Catalogued vehicle lengths run 15-40 ft, most sites 30 ft; only site 022 takes 40 ft and sites 007, 009, 010 32 ft. 3 pull-throughs. Camp host usually at site 2.

sites.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 231875 (type, reservable flag, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/buffalo-campground ('The are 38 campsites available. 24 sites are reservable, and 14 sites are first-come, first-served.'; 'On-site Host is usually at campsite #2.'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/buffalo-campground ('Buffalo Campground does not have electricity or water hook-ups'; 'No dump station or hook-ups are available.') + recreation.gov catalog (all sites STANDARD/TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No water: bring all you need. Nearest dump station is Chatfield State Park, Littleton.

The closest dump station is Chatfield Lake State Park in Littleton.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231875 (notice 'No water available. Bring all the water you will need for your stay.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Typically open early May to late September, depending on weather.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/buffalo-campground ('The campground is typically open from early May to late September, depending on weather conditions.'; Seasons of Use 'Early May to late September'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 24 sites reservable on recreation.gov (or 877-444-6777) at least 4 days ahead; the rest first-come, and unreserved sites are first-come too (must be occupied the same night). Friday+Saturday minimum on weekends, 3 nights on holiday weekends; walk-ups are exempt from the minimums. 2026 reservable (Peak) season May 15 - Sep 6, with first-come walk-in seasons May 1-14 and Sep 7-19; recreation.gov's 2027 Peak season is Jun 5 - Sep 5.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/buffalo-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231875 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 4) + /rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-06; First-come seasons 2026-05-01..05-14 and 2026-09-07..09-19; 2027 Peak 2027-06-05..09-05), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $28/night includes two vehicles or one RV; third vehicle $11. Cash, check or money order at the self-service fee tube for walk-ups. Same rate listed for 2027.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/buffalo-campground ('Single Site: $28 per night / Additional Vehicle Fee: $11 for third vehicle'; 'Two vehicles or one recreation vehicle (RV) per site is included in the camping fee.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231875/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28), read 2026-10-28

note: Pike-San Isabel NF (South Platte RD) campground in the Buffalo Creek Recreation Area at ~7,400 ft, 5 mi west on FR 550 off Jefferson County Road 126 south of Pine Junction. Creek access across from the entrance; several trailheads (Colorado Trail, the Buffalo Creek trail system) within walking distance. A bear closure order is in force: store attractants in hard-sided vehicles or bear boxes. --Claude
